inputs.label: Quake II (original, not the rerelease)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Quake II. qgp uses the original baseq2 folder, not the rerelease folder.

steps.why: The first launch creates /sdcard/Quake2Quest/ and copies a shareware pak0.pak plus pak6.pak and pak99.pak, which the push then completes.
pak0.pak alone is the shareware game; pak1.pak and pak2.pak show the full game is there.

notes: The files go into Quake2Quest itself, not a baseq2 subfolder. The Steam app ID 2320 and the install folder Quake 2 come from the payload and the guide. GOG and other stores are not mentioned by the guide.
